approved: Brisbane Airport Curfew and Demand Management Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would introduce a curfew and other rules at Brisbane Airport to control flights, noise and effects on nearby communities.
It would also set up a process for long-term planning that involves consultation.
The entire Act would start the day after it receives Royal Assent.
Imposes a curfew at Brisbane Airport.
Manages air traffic, flight noise and community impacts.
Ensures consultative, long-term planning for future development.
People living near Brisbane Airport, airlines and other airport users.
